title: 961. Largest Perimeter Triangle

examples.explanation: The three sticks form a valid triangle with perimeter 2+1+2 = 5.
No triple satisfies the triangle rule, so the answer is 0.

hints: Sort the sticks so any candidate triple appears as three consecutive values.
Scan from the largest end: the first consecutive triple with small + middle > large gives the maximum perimeter.
Return 0 when the scan finishes without finding such a triple.
